gloss: to miss hearing; to fail to catch

definitions.gloss: to miss hearing; to fail to catch (what was said)
definitions.explanation: To fail to hear or register something that was said, either because of inattention, noise, or other distractions.

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}な{部分|ぶぶん}を{聞|き}き{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I missed hearing the important part.

examples.japanese: {周|まわ}りがうるさくて{名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}き{落|お}としてしまった。
examples.english: It was so noisy around me that I missed catching the name.

examples.japanese: アナウンスを{聞|き}き{落|お}とさないように{注意|ちゅうい}してください。
examples.english: Please pay attention so you don't miss the announcement.

notes:
A compound verb: {聞|き}く (to hear) + {落|お}とす (to drop, to miss). The pattern verb + {落|お}とす means 'to fail to do' or 'to miss doing.'

THE VERB + {落|お}とす PATTERN:
When attached to another verb stem, {落|お}とす means 'to fail to ~' or 'to miss ~ing':
- {見落|みお}とす: to overlook, to miss seeing
- {聞|き}き{落|お}とす: to miss hearing
- {読|よ}み{落|お}とす: to miss reading, to skip over
- {書|か}き{落|お}とす: to omit writing

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {名前|なまえ}を{聞|き}き{落|お}とす: to miss catching a name
- アナウンスを{聞|き}き{落|お}とす: to miss an announcement
- {大事|だいじ}なことを{聞|き}き{落|お}とす: to miss something important

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {聞|き}き{逃|のが}す: to miss hearing — very similar, slightly more casual
- {聞|き}き{漏|も}らす: to fail to hear — also very similar, slightly more formal
